title: Host Mode, Big Screen, and Guest Experience

steps.say: On the night, Host Mode runs on three screens at once: your phone, the TV, and every guest's phone.
Your phone is the console. Live shows what's up next, and tonight's games.
The big screen goes on the TV or projector. Just open its link in the TV's browser.
It welcomes everyone and shows a code to scan, so guests can join the games.
Guests don't need an app. They type their name and pick a picture.
Then they answer one fun question about themselves, and tap Join.
Back on your phone, tap Go live on a game. Every phone counts down together.
And the big screen follows along, with team scores and the leaderboard.
One phone runs the whole room. Next up: connecting and using the big screen.
